# @example/weather

<!-- Generated by crucible. Change the model or the SDK configuration and regenerate. -->

The TypeScript client for the Weather API (`example.weather#Weather`, API version `2026-10-01`, sent as `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request), generated by [Crucible](https://github.com/Operation-Leyline/crucible) from the service's model.

## Install

```sh
npm install @example/weather@0.0.0-dev
```

The package is `@example/weather`, version `0.0.0-dev`; code refers to it as `@example/weather`.

## Create a client

```ts
import { WeatherClient } from "@example/weather";
import type * as models from "@example/weather";

const client = new WeatherClient({ token: process.env.WEATHER_TOKEN });
```

`token` is the bearer token: a string, or a function returning one or a promise of one, called for every attempt so a refreshed token is used. The client sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request, and `x-amz-content-sha256` (content-sha256) on every POST, PUT and PATCH (the empty body's digest when there is none) and any other request with a body.

## Call an operation

`getCity` calls `GetCity`. Every operation has a method like it.

```ts
import { NotFoundError, WeatherClient } from "@example/weather";
import type * as models from "@example/weather";

// The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request, and x-amz-content-sha256 (content-sha256) on every POST, PUT and PATCH (the empty body's digest when there is none) and any other request with a body.
const client = new WeatherClient({ token: process.env.WEATHER_TOKEN });

// Values from the model's example "Read a city".
const input: models.GetCityInput = {
  cityId: "c-0a1b2c3d",
  at: new Date("2026-01-02T03:04:05Z"),
};

try {
  const output = await client.getCity(input);
  console.log(output.city);
  console.log(output.forecast);
  console.log(output.requestId);
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {
    console.error(`NotFoundError (HTTP ${error.$metadata.status}):`, error.message);
  } else {
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## Pagination

A paginated operation also has a `paginate<Operation>` method returning an async iterator of pages (`for await (const page of client.paginateListCities(input))`): each page is one response, and it stops when the response carries no next token.

```ts
import { WeatherClient } from "@example/weather";
import type * as models from "@example/weather";

// The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request, and x-amz-content-sha256 (content-sha256) on every POST, PUT and PATCH (the empty body's digest when there is none) and any other request with a body.
const client = new WeatherClient({ token: process.env.WEATHER_TOKEN });

// Values from the model's example "List the first page".
const input: models.ListCitiesInput = {
  maxResults: 2,
  tags: [
    "coastal",
    "capital",
  ],
};

// Each page is one response; the paginator sends `nextToken` for the next.
for await (const page of client.paginateListCities(input)) {
  console.log(page.cities);
}
```

## Errors

Each modelled error is a class exported from the package, extending `WeatherException` and `ServiceError`: test it with `instanceof` and read its fields and `$metadata.status`. Transport failures throw `NetworkError`; an exhausted `timeoutMs` throws `TimeoutError`.

## Retries and idempotency

Calls are retried with backoff when a retry is safe: a modelled throttling error is retried for any operation; transport failures, HTTP 500, 502, 503 and 504 and other retryable modelled errors only for operations that are read-only, idempotent or carry an idempotency token. An idempotency token the caller leaves unset is generated once per call and reused on every attempt; set it yourself to replay one logical request across calls. These operations fill a token: `createCity` (`clientToken`). Set `retry: { maxAttempts }` in the client configuration to change the attempt limit (3, the first included), or `retry: false` to turn retries off.
